messages:
rachel: quick alert — publish for samplekit blocked by regen-diff + flaky auth tests. CI stopped at the regen check. @ben @akiko

ben: can you paste the failed CI output?

rachel: ci-bot: [build 8210] nodejs-sdk/regendiff-check failed

rachel: ```diff
--- a/src/client.ts
+++ b/src/client.ts
@@ -14,7 +14,7 @@
-  authRetry?: boolean;
+  maxRetries?: number;
```

akiko: that looks like a rename + type change (boolean -> number). iirc typegen 3.2 changed retry surface and default backoff. did someone bump it in workspace devDeps?

ben: devops note: devs generated on mac/arm with the candidate generator; CI runs linux/x64 with older pinned version so we get nondet ordering + real semantic change. two separate problems.

rachel: quickest unblock is to pin @redwood/typegen to 3.1.x in the SDKs and push a patch. longer term we need pre-publish guards.

akiko: proposed guards: (1) run typegen in a linux-x64 CI container as part of regen-check to avoid platform ordering diffs, (2) add a semantic-diff check that heuristically flags renames/type-changes for fields with keywords: retry/backoff/auth/timeout and require a changelog entry and owner sign-off.

ben: agreed. also add a note to the release playbook: if the semantic-diff flags something, you must either pin the generator for a patch or intentionally bump SDK semver and add explicit migration notes.

rachel: opened hotfix branch samplekit/pin-typegen-3.1 and PR #429. filed devex issue #540 "typegen: detect auth/retry/backoff shape changes + run linux-x64 regen in CI" with repro steps and suggested heuristics.

release-bot: patch release requested: samplekit@0.8.3 -> awaiting CI green

ben: once hotfix merges we'll ship patch to unblock users. follow-up: schedule a small spike to prototype the semantic-diff check and add a test helper for sample apps that asserts observable retry behaviour (count) instead of timing-dependent backoff assertions.

akiko: thanks — i'll add the playbook note and sketch the lint PR in the issue. :white_check_mark:
